test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word.

We urge regulators to adopt a __pragmatic__ and proportionate approach until a sustainable long-term solution can be reached.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pragmatic"** means dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations. (व्यावहारिक)

 
 
• **Example: **She took a **pragmatic** approach to the problem and found a practical solution.
 
 
 
• **"Idealistic"** refers to the attitude of a person who believes in the pursuit of noble ideals, often without regard to practical considerations. (आदर्शवादी)
 
 
• **Example: **His **idealistic** views often clash with the harsh realities of the world.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'pragmatic'** is **'idealistic'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Practical **(व्यावहारिक): Concerned with the actual doing or use of something rather than with theory and ideas.

 
 
• **Example:** Her **practical **approach to problems always leads to effective solutions.
 
 
 
• **Logical **(तार्किक): Of or according to the rules of logic or formal argument.
 
 
• **Example: **It is** logical** to assume that if the sun rises, it will set.
 
 
 
• **Sober** (गंभीर): Serious, sensible, and solemn.
 
 
• **Example:** He is always **sober** and rarely indulges in frivolity.
